findings.evidence: `pkg/planner/core/optimizer.go:265` switches on `sctx.GetSessionVars().EnableCascadesPlanner` (field), not `SessionVars.GetEnableCascadesPlanner()` (hint-aware). The hint is still parsed into `StmtCtx` (`pkg/util/hint/hint.go:430-439`) and the intended hint-override accessor exists (`pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go:2320-2326`), but planner code no longer calls `GetEnableCascadesPlanner()` (search finds only its definition). Before this commit, the decision point used `sessVars.GetEnableCascadesPlanner()` (`pkg/planner/optimize.go` in first parent at line ~502).
findings.fix: Use hint-aware logic when choosing the cascades path, e.g. change the gate in `doOptimize` to `if sctx.GetSessionVars().GetEnableCascadesPlanner() { ... }` (or equivalent), rather than reading the raw `EnableCascadesPlanner` field.
findings.impact: `/*+ USE_CASCADES(...) */` becomes a silent no-op for planner selection: it can no longer enable cascades for a single statement when the session var is off, nor disable cascades per statement when the session var is on. This is a compatibility regression for optimizer-hint behavior and can lead to unexpected plan/performance changes and remove an important per-query workaround knob.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on `upstream/master` (3b531d4e3d99...): `optimizer.go` still gates on the `EnableCascadesPlanner` field (line ~288 in upstream/master version), and `git grep GetEnableCascadesPlanner` on upstream/master finds only its definition in `session.go`.
findings.verify: Add a planner unit/integration test that sets `SessionVars.EnableCascadesPlanner=true` but `StmtCtx.HasEnableCascadesPlannerHint=true` with `StmtCtx.EnableCascadesPlanner=false` (and vice versa) and asserts the chosen optimization path follows the hint override (e.g., via a small observable marker differentiating `OptimizeV1` vs `OptimizeV2`).
findings.what: `USE_CASCADES()` statement hint is silently ignored when selecting the planner path; only `SessionVars.EnableCascadesPlanner` is consulted.

subject: planner: add cascades portal for later optimization. (#58536)
summary: This commit introduces an `OptimizeV1`/`OptimizeV2` split as a new cascades “portal” and removes the old cascades optimizer entrypoint, but the new gate reads the raw session variable field and drops support for the existing `USE_CASCADES()` statement hint override.
